text.p: M-Wave Inc, which makes microwave printed circuit boards used in wireless communications, said Friday Michael Bayles, 45, joined the company as president and chief operating officer.
He takes over as president from Joe Turek, who remains chairman and chief executive officer. Bayles' title as chief operating officer is a new postition at the company.
"The appointment of a senior executive dedicated to managing operations adds significant depth to our management team," Turek said in a statement.
Bayles had previously been president of Varlen Instruments Inc a division of Varlen Corp.

"In 1996, we focused on streamlining operations, solving manufacturing problems, and improving productivity and customer satisfaction," Turek said. "In 1997, we intend to focus on maintaining high levels of operational efficiency and productivity, while adding new business."
